timeline.content:
- Kai has expressive aphasia from a past stroke and communicates partly by writing and sketching, needing a room that provides whiteboard support.
- Kai has a medical follow-up during Monday 9:00-10:00.
- Kai has an HR meeting about a complaint filed against them during Tuesday 11:00-12:00.
- Kai has a call with an outside headhunter during Wednesday 10:00-11:00.
- After a negative performance review, Kai is worried that holding architecture review MEET-001 (Executive Briefing Prep) in a larger room will make it easier for additional leaders to attend and scrutinize them.
- Kai is interviewing with another company after receiving a recruiter referral.
timeline.author: Kai

timeline.content:
- Mika avoids Cedar because they had a tense argument with leadership there last week.
- Mika is worried about a recent mortgage payment increase of several hundred dollars.

timeline.content: Schedule each outstanding meeting in one room and one time window. Consult each attendee for any relevant scheduling information, including availability, constraints, preferences, and other context that may affect the schedule, then choose a schedule that satisfies the room inventory and meeting requirements. Return JSON with shape: {"schedule": {"MEET-001": {"slot": "SLOT_ID", "room": "ROOM_ID"}}} and include an explanation of why the schedule was chosen.
